title: Focus group on analyzing your own data on the Knowledge Portal Network
summary: Interested in analyzing your own data on the Knowledge Portal Network? Join our focus group next Thursday, May 8th from 12-1 PM ET to learn more from KPN team members Drew Hite and Lucas Nguyen!
bodyHtml:
Interested in analyzing your own data on the Knowledge Portal Network? Join our focus group next Thursday, May 8th from 12-1 PM ET to learn more from KPN team members Drew Hite and Lucas Nguyen!

Details on joining the presentation are below and are also embedded in this flyer. Please circulate it to interested colleagues! We hope to see you there, but we’ll also record and post the presentation for those who can’t make it.
